cost of both
⋮ and so on for every n
why, in one line: residues mod 16
λ₁ always lands on 8, because ℓP is a multiple of b = 16.
Every cost step sits at λ ≡ 55 (mod 64), and all of those are 7.
8 is never 7, so λ₁ is never the last value of a tread:
λ₁ and λ₃ = λ₁ + 1 share a tread for every n.
So the oracle has exactly two values
